rows.value: Plant it, defend it, buy better guns. Counter-Strike rounds on Pandora.

A solo best-of-5 bomb-plant/defuse match against Hyperion bots with AI teammates. Earn cash for kills, plants and defuses, and spend it in the buy phase each round. Counter-Strike's round rules, played in Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel.
